title: Real-Time AI Sales Coaching: When Live Guidance Helps
summary: Learn when live AI coaching helps sales reps, when prompts get in the way, and how to test the product with a focused pilot.
body_markdown:
Area


Question to test


Evidence


Timing


Does the cue arrive early enough to help?


Screen recording and call timestamp


Attention


Does the rep miss buyer language while reading prompts?


Rep interview and call review


Accuracy


Is the suggested information correct for the account and product?


Source check by the content owner


Restraint


Can the system stay quiet when no cue is useful?


Prompt count and manager review


Control


Can admins define, edit, and remove cues?


Admin walkthrough


Privacy


Are consent, retention, access, and deletion rules clear?


Legal and security review


Transfer


Does the rep need fewer cues after practice?


Later-call review
